summary: FAT file system on the SD card with write access: DFS v1 + elm-FAT, mounted at '/' at boot, msh file commands (ls cat echo mkdir rm df mkfs).
readme: TinyUSB MSC example: an inserted SD card shows up on the PC as a USB drive and is used as the board's file system

files.what: mounts the card at '/' at boot (INIT_ENV_EXPORT) and watches card detect on RA_SDHI_CD_PIN; vision_board_blink_led's copy has the export commented out and polls a hard-coded p405

source_checks.what: mkfs available (FF_USE_MKFS 1) - msh `mkfs -t elm sd` formats a card
file timestamps from time() (FF_FS_NORTC 0) - without an RTC set, files get the build-time/epoch date
msh file commands (ls, cat, echo <text> <file>, mkdir, rm, df, mkfs) compiled with DFS
the card is mounted at boot

notes: Cards up to 32 GB (FAT32); exFAT cards need RT_DFS_ELM_USE_EXFAT (not set in the SDK projects).
The test writes and deletes /fwtest on the card; nothing else on the card is touched.
evidence: SDK VISION-BOARD 1.3.0 projects/vision_board_openmv (same mnt.c, elm values)
